pantauBanjir.reasonEn: Portal did not respond on 11 October 2026 (HTTP and HTTPS, 45 s limit). Live water-level readings are not imported; this is not a no-flood reading.

petaBencanaGauges.reasonId: Endpoint gauge PetaBencana mengembalikan topologi kosong pada pemeriksaan; tidak ada data pamantauan.
